origin.description: Initialize an object on data, dispatching on its class (an S3 generic in R).

arguments.name: object
arguments.text: an object to initialize, such as a corStruct or varFunc

arguments.name: data
arguments.text: a data frame giving the covariates and groups

origin.details: Dispatches to the method for the object class.
origin.example:
.libPaths(c(path.expand("~/R/library"), .libPaths()))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(nlme))
data <- data.frame(x = c(0, 1, 0.5, 2), y = c(0, 0, 1, 0.5))
cs <- Initialize(corLin(2.5, form = ~ x + y, metric = "eu"), data)
print(round(corMatrix(cs), 4))

translation.description: Dispatch Initialize to the Python initialize function for the object class.

arguments.name: object
arguments.text: a corLin, corRatio, corSpher, corSymm, corCompSymm, varIdent, or varPower object

arguments.name: data
arguments.text: a mapping of column name to values, or a data frame stand-in

translation.details: Classes without a translated initialize (for example corAR1, glsStruct, gnlsStruct) raise TypeError with R's 'no applicable method' message until their method is translated.
translation.example:
import numpy as np

from nlme.corlin import corLin, corMatrix
from nlme.initialize import Initialize

data = {"x": [0.0, 1.0, 0.5, 2.0], "y": [0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 0.5]}
cs = Initialize(corLin(2.5, form="~ x + y", metric="eu"), data)
print(np.round(corMatrix(cs), 4))
